scenario: The ego vehicle turns left at a 4-way intersection while an adversarial vehicle travels straight through the intersection from the left.

ego.behavior: The car turns left at the intersection and continues forward into the new road.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight through the intersection from left to right.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts on the south approach of a 4-way intersection, and the adversarial vehicle starts on the west approach traveling eastbound through the intersection.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must yield to the adversarial vehicle traveling straight through the intersection; the scenario terminates once the ego completes its left turn and clears the intersection.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the blue car from first-person perspective; the purple car is adversarial. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initially both approach intersection; midpoint ego initiates left turn while adversarial proceeds straight; ending ego completes turn as adversarial exits intersection. 4. Evidence: ego's curved arrow shows left-turn trajectory; adversarial's straight arrow shows constant forward motion across intersection.
